versions.subject: Rule: Suspicious executions in web folders / non-exe folders
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image: 
        - '*\wwwroot\*'
        - '*\wmpub\*'
        - '*\htdocs\*'          
filter:
    Image: 
        - '*bin\*'
        - '*\Tools\*'
        - '*\SMSComponent\*'
    ParentImage:
        - '*\services.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image IN ("*\\wwwroot\*", "*\\wmpub\*", "*\\htdocs\*") NOT (Image IN ("*bin\*", "*\\Tools\*", "*\\SMSComponent\*") ParentImage="*\\services.exe")
